CustomObject.description: Configurable weights for the multi-tier cascading risk SCORE formula (docs/multi-tier-risk-rollup.md): New Score = (Own Score x Own_Score_Weight__c) + (avg of weighted sub-supplier contributions x Sub_Supplier_Weight__c), where each sub-supplier's contribution is its own score x its Relationship_Type_To_Parent__c weight. One "Default" record is read by MultiTierRollupService; add more records only if per-domain/per-tier overrides are ever needed.
CustomObject.label: Risk Rollup Setting
